verdict.rationale: Caveman is more than a single agent: it is a platform with a proxy, Cloud computers, billing, guardrails and an OpenAPI-documented service, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party MCP server or an 'mcp serve' mode. The plugin support, the agent wrapping and the OpenAPI spec are client-side or adjacent building blocks and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
